description: Source code for diffcore break logic in a version control system, handling file pair breaking and merging based on edit distance criteria.

methods.name: should_break
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be considered a rewrite and broken into delete and create based on edit distance and size criteria.

methods.name: diffcore_break
methods.description: Breaks file pairs in the diff queue into delete and create pairs if they meet criteria indicating a rewrite.

methods.name: merge_broken
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair if they are complementary parts of a broken pair.

methods.name: diffcore_merge_broken
methods.description: Iterates over the diff queue to merge back broken pairs that have survived rename/copy operations.
